info.name: SentryScore POC API
info.description:
Real-time fraud scoring for a single credit-card transaction.

This is a proof-of-concept inference API (FastAPI + LightGBM) trained on Kaggle's public "IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection" competition dataset (`train_transaction.csv` + `train_identity.csv`, left-joined on `TransactionID`). It has not been validated against real transaction data — see `docs/business-domain-knowhow/README.md` in the repository before relying on any number here for more than evaluation.

The threshold (`BLOCK_THRESHOLD = 0.2891` in `main.py`) is the F1-optimal cutoff on this model's own validation split — a real derivation, but a statistical one, not a cost-calibrated business decision.

## Request fields

| Field | Type | Required | Source column | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction_amt` | number ≥ 0 | yes | `TransactionAmt` | Transaction payment amount, in USD. |
| `product_cd` | string | yes | `ProductCD` | Product/category code purchased. Observed values: `W`, `C`, `R`, `H`, `S` — individual meaning not disclosed by Vesta. |
| `card.card1` | number\|null | yes (object) | `card1` | Anonymized numeric card-issuer identifier; exact encoding undisclosed by Vesta. |
| `card.card2` | number\|null | | `card2` | Anonymized numeric card-related identifier; encoding undisclosed. |
| `card.card3` | number\|null | | `card3` | Anonymized numeric card-related identifier; encoding undisclosed. |
| `card.card4` | string\|null | | `card4` | Card payment network — e.g. "visa", "mastercard", "american express", "discover". |
| `card.card5` | number\|null | | `card5` | Anonymized numeric card-related identifier; encoding undisclosed. |
| `card.card6` | string\|null | | `card6` | Card funding type — e.g. "debit", "credit". |
| `addr1` | number\|null | no | `addr1` | Billing-address region code. Not individually documented by Vesta. |
| `addr2` | number\|null | no | `addr2` | Billing-address country code. Same disclosure caveat as `addr1`. |
| `dist1` | number\|null | no | `dist1` | A distance-type signal (e.g. billing vs. shipping address). Exact definition undisclosed. |
| `dist2` | number\|null | no | `dist2` | A second distance-type signal. Same caveat as `dist1`. |
| `p_email_domain` | string\|null | no | `P_emaildomain` | Purchaser's email domain, e.g. "gmail.com". |
| `r_email_domain` | string\|null | no | `R_emaildomain` | Recipient's email domain, when known. |
| `velocity_counts` | (number\|null)[14] | yes | `C1`-`C14` | Vesta-engineered count features (e.g. "how many addresses are found to be associated with the payment card"). Individual columns undisclosed. Exactly 14 values, in order. |
| `time_deltas` | (number\|null)[15] | yes | `D1`-`D15` | Vesta-engineered time-delta features (e.g. "days between previous transaction"). Individual columns undisclosed. Exactly 15 values, in order. |
| `match_flags` | (string\|null)[9] | yes | `M1`-`M9` | Vesta-engineered match flags (e.g. "names on card and address"), typically `"T"`/`"F"`/null. Individual columns undisclosed. Exactly 9 values, in order. |
| `vesta_features` | (number\|null)[339] | yes | `V1`-`V339` | Vesta's proprietary engineered features ("ranking, counting, and other entity relations"). Largest, least interpretable input block. Exactly 339 values, in order. |
| `identity` | object or omitted | no | `train_identity.csv` (left-joined on `TransactionID`) | Device/network signals. Present for only ~24% of transactions in training data — omit this entire field (don't send null sub-fields) when absent. |
| `identity.device_type` | string\|null | | `DeviceType` | e.g. "mobile", "desktop". |
| `identity.device_info` | string\|null | | `DeviceInfo` | Free-text device/browser string, e.g. "Windows", "iOS Device". |
| `identity.identity_features` | (number\|string\|null)[38] | yes (within `identity`) | `id_01`-`id_38` | Network/device fingerprinting signals (IP/ISP/proxy, browser/OS fingerprint) collected by Vesta's fraud-protection partners. Individual columns undisclosed. Exactly 38 values, in order. |

## Response fields (200)

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `fraud_probability` | number, 0-1 | `model.predict_proba(...)[0][1]`, rounded to 4 decimals. Research-quality number from a public dataset — not a calibrated real-world risk score. |
| `is_blocked` | boolean | `true` when `fraud_probability` > `BLOCK_THRESHOLD` (0.2891, hardcoded in `main.py`). |
| `action` | `"PASS"` \| `"BLOCK"` | Human-readable restatement of `is_blocked`. |

## Validation error fields (422)

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `detail[].loc` | Path to the invalid field, e.g. `["body", "vesta_features"]`. |
| `detail[].msg` | Human-readable description of what failed validation. |
| `detail[].type` | Machine-readable error category, e.g. `"too_short"`, `"missing"`, `"greater_than_equal"`. |
